Jordan (Product): Heads up: several customers asked for guaranteed higher burst for Performance tier. Proposing a Performance+ SKU with 3x short bursts and priority routing.
Priya (Sales): Customers: games platform + adtech. They want predictable spikes during launches. They'll pay if SLAs/backstop included.
Ravi (Finance): 3x bursts unpriced will tank margin. Need clear metering: either included limited credits or paid burst buckets.
Theo (Engineering): Tech notes: priority routing requires priority queues + separate workers or token-exchange. Also KV cache warm-up impacts cold-starts for bursts.
Jordan (Product): Option 1: Performance+ SKU (higher monthly + some burst credits). Option 2: Pay-as-you-surge buckets (prepaid credits). Option 3: Pilot-only temporary boosts. Thoughts?
Nora (Legal): If we promise 3x, contract must limit liability and define what "guaranteed" means (time windows, degraded SLAs). Also require abuse protection.
Priya (Sales): Customers lean to 1 (simple SKU). Prefer monthly predictable cost.
Ravi (Finance): Model pricing: base + $X per 1M token burst credit. Quick calc: to maintain margin, list price should be ~1.6x Performance, with 25% burst included, extra at 1.8x.
Theo (Engineering): Implementation effort: separate priority lane + monitoring ~3 sprints; burst bucket meter + billing ~1 sprint. If we want fast go-to-market, start with prepaid burst credits (Option 2) then mature to SKU.
Jordan (Product): Proposal: stage 1 = prepaid burst buckets (fast), stage 2 = Performance+ SKU (if adoption justifies infra). Launch checklist for stage 1: billing meter, console purchase flow, docs, contract addendum, routing soft prioritization.
Priya (Sales): I'll pitch stage 1 to pilot accounts. Need a price sheet and sample contract clause.
Nora (Legal): Draft clause: "Performance burst credits allow up to 3x capacity for covered routes for short bursts. Excess or sustained usage beyond credits subject to overage rates and mitigation measures."
Ravi (Finance): Approve sample numbers for pilot: $15k/mo for 50M burst tokens bucket, overage at 1.8x. Show modeled PnL for top-10 customers.
Theo (Engineering): Monitoring/alerts: burst-consumption > 80% of bucket, p95 latency delta > 40% vs baseline, queue-length > threshold. We'll add flags to disable priority routing for noisy tenants.
BillingBot: Billing feature request created: BF-4092. Docs stub: https://redwood.internal/billing/BF-4092
Jordan (Product): ETA for stage 1: 2 weeks for billing + docs + legal template, 3 weeks end-to-end with console flow. Can we do 2-week pilot ramp?
Priya (Sales): Yes, I'll coordinate pilots and collect commitment signatures.
Ravi (Finance): I'll finalize pricing cadence and reporting to ops. Need telemetry to reconcile prepaid buckets.
Nora (Legal): I'll produce a small addendum template and an internal playbook for disputes.
Theo (Engineering): We'll spin up a canary for priority flags and capacity gating. Ping me when pilots start.
Jordan (Product): Great. Stage 1 go approved. Follow-up: revisit permanent SKU decision after 2 pilots or $X ARR threshold.
